case.title: Choosing technicians hides every other group and column, pinned ones too
case.custom_preconds:
• Owner/Admin with Work Orders View and Create & Edit permissions; browser at least 1024 px wide. Active, clockable technicians A, B and C are eligible at this location.
  • For one unique customer, create Approved work orders: WO1 led by A; WO2 by B; WO3 by C; WO4 unassigned; WO5 led by C with A assigned only to a line item.
  • Pin C’s Board View column. Clear filters, turn Assigned to me off and use the All tab.

Source: PRD v60, S1-R15 and S1-R3.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Tech View and search for the test customer.
  2. Select Unassigned and A in the Technician filter; close the options.
  3. Switch to Board View.
  4. Clear only the Technician selection.
case.custom_expected:
Step 1: WO1–WO5 are available in their lead-technician groups before applying the Technician filter.

Step 2: Only Unassigned and A groups remain, showing WO4 and WO1. B and C are hidden. WO5 is excluded because its lead is C, even though A is a line-item technician.

Step 3: The same selection is retained. Only Unassigned/WO4 and A/WO1 appear; all other columns, including pinned C, are hidden. WO5 remains excluded.

Step 4: All technician groups/columns are restored for the customer’s results, including WO2, WO3 and WO5. C is still pinned.

Last checked against build v26.40.20-0509710 (staging) on 10/20/2026.

changes.label: Preconditions
changes.old_value:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner or Admin user whose role has Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit, at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 px wide, so the display switcher (List, Tech View, Board View) shows at the right of the Work Orders toolbar.
  • Technician {Technician-A} (for example Esther Howard) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-B} (for example Ralph Edwards) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Technician {Technician-C} (for example Dana Ortiz) is an active staff member at {Location-A} with Time Clock on and a Role other than Office User or Time Clock User.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example "ZZAUTOTEST NT2 Technician Filter Groups") is used by this case only.
  • Approved work orders {Work-order-1} (for example S10043-17622), {Work-order-2} (for example S10043-17623) and {Work-order-3} (for example S10043-17624) for {Customer-A} are led by {Technician-A}, {Technician-B} and {Technician-C}, one each.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-4} (for example S10043-17625) for {Customer-A} has no lead technician.
  • Approved work order {Work-order-5} (for example S10043-17626) for {Customer-A} is led by {Technician-C}, and its line {Line-1} (for example "Service - Full grease service") is given to {Technician-A}.
  • {Technician-C} is pinned for you in Board View.
  • On the Work Orders page nothing is chosen in any filter, Assigned to me is off and Search is empty.

changes.label: Steps
changes.old_value:
1. Open Work Orders and click the All tab.
  2. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  3. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  4. Click the Technician filter.
  5. Tick Unassigned.
  6. Tick {Technician-A} (open the Technician filter again first if the list closed).
  7. Click outside the Technician filter list to close it.
  8. Read the group headers and the work orders under each.
  9. Click Board View in the display switcher.
  10. Read the column headers and the cards in each column.
  11. Click the Technician filter and clear the selection.
  12. Read the column headers.
changes.new_value:
1. Open Tech View and search for the test customer.
  2. Select Unassigned and A in the Technician filter; close the options.
  3. Switch to Board View.
  4. Clear only the Technician selection.

changes.label: Expected Result
changes.old_value:
Expected results

  • Step 8: Tech View shows only two groups, Unassigned (holding {Work-order-4}) and {Technician-A} (holding {Work-order-1}). The {Technician-B} and {Technician-C} groups are hidden.
  • Step 8: {Work-order-5} is not shown, although {Technician-A} works on its line: the filter goes by lead technician only.
  • Step 10: Board View shows only the Unassigned and {Technician-A} columns, holding {Work-order-4} and {Work-order-1}. The pinned {Technician-C} column is hidden, and {Work-order-5} is not shown.
  • Step 12: with nothing chosen, every column shows again, and {Technician-C}'s column is still pinned.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10044 (Story 1, Switch between display options); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 52 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R15 (added in version 52 on 14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward ruling after Sasha Grosman's staging review follow-up), read 14 Oct 2026. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build. S1-R3 (filters kept when switching display).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R15: “In Tech View and Board View the filter bar also offers a Technician filter, after Assigned to me. It is a multi-select listing Unassigned first, then the location’s technicians (the same people who get a group or column, S9-R4), by first name then last name. Choosing one or more shows only those technicians’ groups or columns; every other group or column, pinned ones included, is hidden. It filters by lead technician only.”
  • S1-R3: “Switching display options immediately re-lays out the current results without changing the filter view, search text, or filters.”
